subject: Zenvera Health — security docs kickoff & trust portal access request
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@zenverahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Zenvera Health — security docs kickoff & trust portal access request

Hi Samira — great to meet you on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

1) SOC 2 status: you mentioned Zenvera completed SOC 2 Type I last quarter and are in-scope for Type II for FY26. Can you confirm the target report period (start/end dates) and whether your auditor will allow a bridge letter for the gap period?

2) Trust portal: we'd like read-only access to your vendor trust portal (or a secure upload) so our security team can pull the SOC 2 report and any bridge letter. I attached a short VSQ (vendor security questionnaire) template to speed initial scoping — please fill the highlighted tabs you can.

3) HIPAA/GDPR: you said HIPAA applicability is limited to a small pilot. Could you confirm whether a BAA will be required for the pilot and whether Safe Harbor/GDPR transfer mechanisms are in place for any EU data?

Next steps I propose: 
- Samira: share portal invite or upload SOC2 Type I report + auditor name (by EOD Fri 8/14)
- Procurement: if a BAA/SOW is needed, please route to procurement and share point of contact for DocuSign
- Ben/Aditya/Tessa (internal): once we have the report, we will review for controls gap and confirm whether a Redwood bridge letter or compensating control notes are needed.

Attachments: Zenvera_VSQ_initial.xlsx; Redwood_bridge_letter_template.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up in a couple days if we don’t see the upload.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0198

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@zenverahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@zenverahealth.com>, security@zenverahealth.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zenvera Health — security docs kickoff & trust portal access request

Hi Monica — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers and requests from our side: 

- SOC2: Correct, Type I completed May 2026. We expect Type II cover window from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 and the audit to complete by mid-November. Our auditor is Kensington & Co — they have allowed bridge letters previously; I’ll confirm.

- Portal: We can grant temporary read-only access to our vendor portal. I’ll ask security to add monica.patel@redwood.ai and ben.carter@redwood.ai.

- BAA/GDPR: For the pilot we do expect a BAA. Procurement will start the BAA/SOW process; procurement@zenverahealth.com will coordinate. For GDPR transfers, we use SCCs and have a DPA in place — I’ll attach the redacted DPA when security uploads docs.

Attached: I completed the high-level tabs of your VSQ and marked items that will need our security team to answer in detail. 

We’ll aim to have portal invites out by EOD Friday 8/14. Let me know if you need anything else to prioritize the audit review.

Best,
Samira Khan
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Zenvera Health
samira.k@zenverahealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@zenverahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zenvera Health — security docs kickoff & trust portal access request

Thanks Samira — appreciate the fast turnaround. A couple quick internal notes and asks: 

- Aditya (cc) — once portal access is granted, can you prioritize a controls review and flag any items that would prevent us using our hosted offering for the pilot? Please target T+2 business days for an initial pass.

- Samira / Procurement — if you can also share the auditor contact at Kensington & Co (email) we may reach out for attestation logistics if needed. 

- On the BAA: we have a standard Redwood BAA template; I’ll send the DocuSign link once procurement confirms the SOW path.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call next week if that helps move approvals along.

– Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Procurement <procurement@zenverahealth.com>
